knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Written permission and any official release are required. A key and a verbal approval are not sufficient.
Owner permission does not replace official release.

practicalCriteria: For a fictional job, the learner writes the authority chain, naming each party and what written permission it holds. Pass: each party is named and its permission is recorded.
The learner marks which authority is missing and holds access in writing. Pass: the hold names the missing authority.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Written permission is missing or unclear.
An official release may apply and is not confirmed.
